title: Crispy Jamaican Plantain Fritters
description: A delicious Caribbean-inspired snack made with ripe plantains, jamaican seasoning, and crispy batter.
instructions: Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch rounds.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, jamaican seasoning, and crispy fried onions.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, buttermilk, and a pinch of salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Add the sliced plantains to the batter and stir until they are evenly coated.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the battered plantain slices to the skillet.
Fry the plantains for about 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
